description: This file implements the 'Value' class and related classes such as DictionaryValue and ListValue, providing a JSON-like data structure with serialization, deep copy, and path-based access functionalities.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a dynamically typed value supporting types like null, boolean, integer, string, binary, dictionary, and list, with methods for cloning, comparison, and path-based access.

classes.name: DictionaryValue
classes.description: A subclass of Value representing a dictionary (map) of string keys to Value objects, supporting nested path access and modification.

classes.name: ListValue
classes.description: A subclass of Value representing a list of Value objects, supporting insertion, removal, and deep copying.

methods.name: CreateWithCopiedBuffer
methods.description: Creates a Value object by copying a buffer.

methods.name: FromUniquePtrValue
methods.description: Creates a Value from a unique_ptr to Value.

methods.name: ToUniquePtrValue
methods.description: Converts a Value into a unique_ptr to Value.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the Value object.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Value object.
